name: TEMPLATE - Gerador de Artigos SEO com IA + WordPress

parameters.content:
## TEMPLATE - Gerador de Artigos SEO com IA + WordPress

### How it works

This workflow runs on a schedule to choose an SEO article topic, generate the article with AI, and prepare the content for publishing. It uses AI agents with an OpenAI chat model and structured parsing to create the article, then converts and organizes the output into WordPress-ready fields such as title, slug, meta description, and HTML content. Finally, it publishes the post to WordPress, sets a featured image, optionally notifies the Google Indexing API, and ends with a pass-through final node.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Schedule Trigger with the desired publishing frequency.
- Update the EscolheTema code node with the blog URL, topic/source logic, and any required article parameters.
- Add valid OpenAI credentials for the AI agent chat model and verify the structured output format expected by the parser.
- Configure WordPress REST API authentication and endpoint details for the PostWP and SetFeaturedImage HTTP Request nodes.
- If using the optional Google Indexing API node, configure a Google Cloud service account with Indexing API access and the required authentication headers/body.

### Customization

You can customize the topic selection logic, AI prompts, article structure, Markdown-to-HTML conversion, WordPress post status/category/tags, featured image behavior, and whether the Google indexing step is enabled.

## Schedule and topic setup

Starts the workflow on a timed schedule and selects or prepares the article topic and blog configuration used by later steps.

## AI article generation

A spatially tight AI cluster that plans and writes the SEO article using agents, an OpenAI chat model, and structured output parsing.

## Format article content

Prepares the generated Markdown/content, converts it to HTML, and organizes final publishing fields like title, slug, meta description, and HTML body.

## Publish to WordPress

Creates the WordPress post through the REST API and then updates it with a featured image.

## Index and finish

Optionally submits the published URL to the Google Indexing API, then completes the workflow with a final pass-through node.
